examples.name: SARSA vs Q-Learning Cliff
examples.description: Tabular SARSA and Q-learning on a cliff grid: on-policy stays inland, off-policy hugs the rim
examples.learningGoal: See why on-policy SARSA avoids the cliff that off-policy Q-learning hugs.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints two greedy policies; Q-learning hugs the cliff and SARSA stays inland.

examples.name: Chain Rule
examples.description: Check d/dx [f(g(x))] = f'(g(x)) * g'(x) against a numerical slope — the product backprop uses
examples.learningGoal: See why backprop multiplies local derivatives before training the XOR net.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints numeric vs analytic derivatives for (2x+1)^3 and a small finite-difference error.

examples.name: Perceptron
examples.description: One neuron with a step activation: AND and OR work, XOR does not
examples.learningGoal: See a single neuron separate AND/OR, then fail on XOR before the hidden layer.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints AND/OR accuracy 4/4 and XOR below 4, then perceptron ok.

examples.name: XOR Neural Net
examples.description: Train a 2-4-1 multilayer perceptron on XOR with backpropagation, from scratch
examples.learningGoal: Read each backprop multiply as the chain-rule product from chain_rule.malda, then watch XOR train.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints the chain-rule equations, a first-sample walkthrough, training loss, and classifies all four XOR inputs correctly.

examples.name: Softmax Classifier
examples.description: Linear softmax + cross-entropy on three 2D blobs using math.matmul
examples.learningGoal: Train a 3-class softmax on 2D points after the XOR MLP.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints accuracy at least 30/36 and softmax classifier ok.

examples.name: Linear SVM
examples.description: Train a soft-margin support vector machine with hinge loss and L2, from scratch
examples.learningGoal: See a max-margin linear separator, then why the same model cannot solve XOR.
examples.expectedOutput: Separates two 2D clusters and reports that linear SVM fails on XOR.

examples.name: Attention Is All You Need
examples.description: Vaswani et al. 2017 Transformer: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head, sinusoidal PE, encoder-decoder, then a tiny reverse trainer
examples.learningGoal: Read the 2017 paper's equations as running MALDA, then watch a single attention head learn to reverse a sequence.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints paper-section walkthroughs, a learned anti-diagonal attention map, and reverse-sequence accuracy.

examples.name: microgpt (Karpathy Port)
examples.description: Pure MALDA port of Karpathy's dependency-free microgpt training and inference loop
examples.learningGoal: Train a tiny decoder-only GPT after the 2017 encoder-decoder walkthrough.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs an advanced MALDA implementation of a GPT-style training and inference loop.

examples.name: Embedding 2D
examples.description: Project hash embeddings onto two axes and list VectorDB neighbors — no GGUF required
examples.learningGoal: See why nearby words sit close after a 2D projection of hash embeddings.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints a 2D table and nearest neighbors for 'car', then embedding 2d ok.

examples.name: ONNX Inspect
examples.description: Load a tiny Identity ONNX graph, print input/output names, run a 2x2 tensor
examples.learningGoal: Inspect a real ONNX graph without training one.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints identity input/output metadata, Y equals X, then onnx inspect ok.

examples.name: Dense layer helpers
examples.description: Train the XOR MLP with nn.dense and nn.denseBackward instead of hand-written chain-rule loops
examples.learningGoal: See the same 2-4-1 XOR net when the local derivative lives in nn.denseBackward.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints training loss and classifies all four XOR inputs, then nn dense ok.

examples.name: Tiny digits (MNIST loop)
examples.description: Train a 5x5 glyph MLP with nn.dense, softmax cross-entropy, and a hand-written learning-rate step — the MNIST loop without the download
examples.learningGoal: Run the chapter 14 two-layer step on ten digit glyphs: ReLU hidden layer, linear logits, nn.softmaxGrad as upstream.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints training loss and classifies all ten glyphs, then mnist digits ok.
